and displaying the Innkeeper cursor above their name.]] The Interact Key allows players to interact with NPCs and objects using a keypress instead of clicking with the mouse. The default keybind is , but it can be customized in the Key Bindings or in the Options → Controls, just below the option to enable the feature. This option can be useful as a quicker, more reliable way to interact with things than clicking. Examples include NPCs surrounded by a crowd of players, objects or creatures that need to be interacted with quickly during combat, and very small objects that may be difficult to accurately click.

The Invasion of Gnomeregan, also known as the fall of Gnomeregan or the Gnomeregan incident, was a conflict that opposed the forces of Gnomeregan against an invasion of troggs awakened from the depths of Uldaman. For five years, the gnomes defended their nation with all their might, until Sicco Thermaplugg's betrayal caused the death of eighty percent of gnomekind, as well as the irradiation of Gnomeregan. On the brink of extinction, High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the survivors went into exile in Ironforge, where they prepared themselves for Operation: Gnomeregan.

]] An invisible bunny, also known as simply a bunny, is an invisible trigger or entity used for various functions in World of Warcraft. Though they're invisible, bunnies and other triggers often have a creature model assigned to them—most commonly a rabbit, hence the name. The original infernal model is also common. As of , many triggers have no assigned model ID. One of bunnies' many functions is to act as a target for NPC spells. If a monster casts a spell at a specific location, they may actually be targeting an invisible bunny. Most bunnies cannot be seen or targeted, though some will obscure in-world UI elements such as names and target circles, and a few are unintentionally left target

Ironhaul Station is the transport hub and staging area between the Ringing Deeps and Dornogal up above on the Isle of Dorn, found in the northwestern part of the zone. Players are directed here at the start of the Ringing Deeps storyline in Into the Deeps.
